articles.title: Robinhood Chain sees over $70M in ETH bridged during first week
articles.snippet: Robinhood’s choice to use Ethereum further solidifies its position as the “ultimate settlement layer and liquidity foundation for tokenized assets,” said HashKey Group’s Tim Sun.

articles.title: Swift Readies Ledger for 24/7 Token Transfers—Though True Settlement Is Stuck on Old Rails
articles.snippet: Swift’s pilot allows 17 global banks to transfer tokenized deposits on weekends, but ultimate settlement still relies on legacy systems.
